items.q: When does SERRES Wrap Center open in Boca Raton?
items.a: Detailing and paint correction start on {{business:openingSoftLabel}}. The full paint protection film launch follows on {{business:openingFullLabel}}. The exact studio location is announced in October 2026.

items.q: How much does paint protection film cost?
items.a: Paint protection film starts at {{price:partial-front.essential}} for a partial front in NAR H190 and {{price:full-front.essential}} for a full front. The 3M Scotchgard Pro Series 200 tier is a step up from there. {{terms:fromMeaning}} {{terms:tax}}
{{terms:warranty}} The installation warranty covers lifting, bubbling or edge failure caused by the fit, and it is ours, not the film maker's.

items.q: Can I get a quote before you open?
items.a: Yes. Send your make, model and the coverage you are after through the quote form and we come back with the exact number. {{terms:deposit}} The studio address and phone line go live in October 2026, so the form is the way in until then.
